connector.name: Sendable
connector.registryDescription: Send transactional email from your editor - describe the event, Sendable writes and sends it.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sendableme-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace me.sendable, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Your Sendable API key. Free at https://www.sendable.me/keys
